# commercetools_recurrence_policy (Resource)

A Recurrence Policy is the schedule Recurring Orders repeat on: every so many days, weeks or months, or on a day of the month.

See also the [Recurrence Policies API documentation](https://docs.commercetools.com/api/projects/recurrence-policies).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "commercetools_recurrence_policy" "monthly" {
  key = "monthly"
  name = {
    en = "Every month"
  }
  schedule {
    type          = "standard"
    value         = 1
    interval_unit = "Months"
  }
}

resource "commercetools_recurrence_policy" "first_of_month" {
  key = "first-of-month"
  schedule {
    type = "dayOfMonth"
    day  = 1
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) User-defined unique identifier of the RecurrencePolicy.

### Optional

- `description` (Map of String) Description of the RecurrencePolicy as localized string.
- `name` (Map of String) Name of the RecurrencePolicy as localized string.
- `schedule` (Block List) When orders repeat: `standard` every `value` `interval_unit`s, or `dayOfMonth` on `day` of every month. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--schedule))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Platform-generated unique identifier of the RecurrencePolicy.
- `version` (Number) Current version of the RecurrencePolicy.

<a id="nestedblock--schedule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedule`

Required:

- `type` (String) `standard` or `dayOfMonth`.

Optional:

- `day` (Number) Day of the month orders are created on, from 1 to 31, for `dayOfMonth`. In a shorter month it is the month's last day.
- `interval_unit` (String) `Days`, `Weeks` or `Months`, for `standard`.
- `value` (Number) How many `interval_unit`s lie between orders, for `standard`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A recurrence policy is imported using its id.
terraform import commercetools_recurrence_policy.monthly 6f1e2a3b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b
```
